solutions.title: Reachable dynamic programming
solutions.strategy: Mark an index reachable if any earlier reachable index can jump to it.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each target index may scan all earlier indexes.

spaceComplexity.explanation: A boolean reachability array stores one state per index.

solutions.title: Greedy farthest reach
solutions.strategy: Track the farthest reachable index while scanning from left to right.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each index is inspected once until the scan fails or reaches the end.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only the farthest reachable index is stored.
